LanguageData.HR_AncientLivingForestSoil.label: Ancient Living Forest Soil
LanguageData.HR_AncientLivingForestSoil.description: Humus, roots, and understory growth have formed a vigorous ancient forest floor. Even after vegetation is cleared, this ground retains its natural capacity for recovery. A constructed floor can suppress plants temporarily, but cannot permanently change the soil's natural identity.
